translations.EN: Fine. Just lower your voice.
translations.TL: Sige. Hinaan mo lang ang boses mo.

translations.EN: Lower your tone before you draw attention.
translations.TL: Hinaan mo ang tono mo bago ka makahatak ng pansin.

translations.EN: Stop yelling. You want every dead head hearing this?
translations.TL: Huwag kang sumigaw. Gusto mo bang marinig tayo ng mga patay?

translations.EN: All right. Keep it down and back off.
translations.TL: Sige. Hinaan ang boses at umatras.

translations.EN: Enough. Lower the volume right now.
translations.TL: Sapat na. Hinaan mo ang boses mo ngayon din.

translations.EN: I heard you. Now drop the shouting.
translations.TL: Narinig kita. Ngayon tigilan mo ang pagsigaw.

translations.EN: Shh! Keep your voice down.
translations.TL: Shh! Hinaan mo ang boses mo.

translations.EN: Keep it civil and quiet. We're in danger.
translations.TL: Maging maayos at tahimik. Nasa panganib tayo.

translations.EN: Lower your voice. I'm not deaf.
translations.TL: Hinaan mo ang boses. Hindi ako bingi.

translations.EN: Fine. Just tone it down.
translations.TL: Sige. Hinaan mo lang.

translations.EN: Easy. We don't need to make this worse.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan. Hindi natin kailangang palalain pa ito.

translations.EN: Let's calm down and talk this through reasonably.
translations.TL: Kumalma tayo at pag-usapan ito nang maayos.

translations.EN: Take a breath. Bickering won't fix anything.
translations.TL: Huminga ka nang malalim. Walang maaayos ang bangayan.

translations.EN: No need for tempers to flare. Let's settle it.
translations.TL: Di kailangang mag-init ang ulo. Ayusin natin.

translations.EN: Easy does it. We're on the same side here.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Magkasama tayo rito.

translations.EN: Let's step back and look at the situation calmly.
translations.TL: Umatras muna tayo at tingnan ang sitwasyon nang mahinahon.

translations.EN: We can resolve this without shouting.
translations.TL: Maaayos natin ito nang hindi sumisigaw.

translations.EN: Keep cool. Let's find a workable solution.
translations.TL: Kumalma ka lang. Maghanap tayo ng maayos na solusyon.

translations.EN: Easy now. Don't lose your head over this.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan lang. Huwag mawalan ng katinuan dahil dito.

translations.EN: Hold on. Let's de-escalate before someone gets hurt.
translations.TL: Teka muna. Huminahon tayo bago may masaktan.

translations.EN: Easy.
translations.TL: Dahan-dahan.

translations.EN: Calm down.
translations.TL: Kumalma ka.

translations.EN: Drop it.
translations.TL: Tama na.

translations.EN: Quiet.
translations.TL: Tahimik.

translations.EN: Breathe.
translations.TL: Huminga ka.

translations.EN: Cool off.
translations.TL: Palamig ka muna.

translations.EN: Steady.
translations.TL: Magpakatatag.

translations.EN: Enough.
translations.TL: Sapat na.

translations.EN: Hold up.
translations.TL: Teka lang.

translations.EN: Stop.
translations.TL: Tigil.

translations.EN: Calm down. This isn't helping either of us.
translations.TL: Kumalma ka. Walang naitutulong ito sa atin.

translations.EN: Hey, look at me. We're friends, remember?
translations.TL: Huy, tingnan mo ako. Magkaibigan tayo, tandaan mo.

translations.EN: Take a breath. I'm right here with you. Let's work it out.
translations.TL: Huminga ka muna. Narito lang ako kasama mo. Aayusin natin 'to.

translations.EN: I know you're stressed. Let's pause and decompress.
translations.TL: Alam kong pagod ka. Huminto muna tayo at magpahinga.

translations.EN: Don't let the anger take over. We care about each other.
translations.TL: Huwag mong hayaang lamunin ka ng galit. May malasakit tayo sa isa't isa.

translations.EN: We're going to get through this, I promise. Calm down.
translations.TL: Malalampasan natin ito, pangako. Kumalma ka na.

translations.EN: I hear your pain. Let's talk gently.
translations.TL: Naririnig ko ang hirap mo. Mag-usap tayo nang mahinahon.

translations.EN: It's all right. I'm listening. Just bring the energy down.
translations.TL: Ayos lang. Nakikinig ako. Ibaba mo lang ang init ng ulo.

translations.EN: We've survived too much together to fight like this.
translations.TL: Masyado na tayong maraming pinagdaanan para mag-away nang ganito.

translations.EN: Peace, friend. We are stronger together.
translations.TL: Kapayapaan, kaibigan. Mas malakas tayo kapag magkasama.
